worker.development_feedback: qualified Python AST/JSON MCP parser; behavior checks remained controller-owned

implemented: Repair broken newline split in existing controller
Reject unknown stages including force overrides
Check closed snapshot schema, explicit unknowns, dependency joins and transitive artifact freshness
Return one deterministic action with a stable snapshot/policy-derived identity
Reconcile uncertain or legacy submission markers; preserve existing review-after-prefill policy

acceptance.limits: Synthetic fixtures, no-op dependency for narrow controller dispatch, independent code inspection before execution; not real PDF/browser/tracker checks.

accounting.note: Includes native smoke and every launched implementation attempt. Native token categories include cache creation/read. Hook coverage remains partial. Preparation and independent review are not free merely because unpriced.
accounting.controller_recording_issue: Build enrollment used normalized-text request hash while dispatch froze raw CRLF bytes. Both identities are preserved and verified; enrollment is not rewritten. Future launcher records both.

next_decision: Exercise the read-only planner with an evidence-producing snapshot adapter before allowing any executor to consume its action. Missing or conflicting external evidence must remain unknown; action identity alone does not deduplicate effects.
